topic: How does the 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna influence frequency planning and spectral efficiency for broadband satellite links?
consensus_response: The 11.6% bandwidth constraint of the CTS antenna limits spectral efficiency, increasing interference and reducing capacity. Optimizing frequency allocation through dynamic channel allocation and adaptive modulation techniques can mitigate this effect, maximizing traffic accommodation rates and enhancing link performance.
reference_context: SatCom systems optimize resource allocation to maximize throughput, with techniques like beamforming and polarization diversity enhancing spectral efficiency.
